# Set password (cms-admin)

## Purpose

The invited person activates the account by entering the code from the invitation and a new password ([password flow](../../flows/password/FLOW.md)).

## Techniques

A view (page) folder registered in `views/Views.registry.ts`; it reads data only through feature facades ([cms-admin rules](../../apps/cms-admin/RULES.md)). A fresh code can be requested here, since one lasts only a few minutes.

## Technologies

React, react-hook-form with Zod.

## Entry points

Route `/set-password`, page `SetPasswordPage`.

## Where to change what

Form fields and rules: the schema in `SetPasswordPage.tsx`; the calls: `features/auth`.
